note: USFS Helena-Lewis & Clark NF campground at MacDonald Pass on the Continental Divide, ~15 mi W of Helena off US-12, near a Continental Divide Trail trailhead. Narrow tree-lined roads but reviewers fit 25-31 ft rigs (site 11 pull-through); largest sites accommodate a 23-ft RV. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed $15/night (fees left, already human-recorded; extra vehicle $5), 15 sites, added vault toilets. Changed potable_water true -> false (FS: 'Potable water is not available at this site'). Not stated on the FS page: FCFS, 14-day limit, season, hookups (derived values left); not listed on recreation.gov, so Forest Service-run and presumably first-come. No current Helena-Lewis & Clark alert names the campground or US-12 at MacDonald Pass. Note: 'water' corrected, restated fee/FCFS/limit trimmed.
flags: Missing phone: the FS page gives no contact number (Helena Ranger District manages it).

Fit evidence is camper-reported only: the FS page gives no site lengths; inclusion rests on Campendium reviews (25-31 ft rigs fit). The FS page's own coordinates (46.3326, -112.1855) are about 25 km off MacDonald Pass; the entry's pin is right.
